title: Search-Regime Conditional Mechanism Transport, MAIN–QSearch Causal Reassignment, Depth/Resource Phase Structure & Dynamic TT-Mediation Stability

fresh_world.freshness_rule: P16-only five-piece material families absent from P13/P14/P15 generator families; generation-index offset 30000

instrument.successor_masking: not part of the primary P16 phase decomposition; MASK_ALL remains a secondary whole-TT anchor

tranche.selection: round-robin across material_signature x side_to_move; within stratum descending minimum site-use floor across all 3 regimes x 2 targets, then tau4, then candidate_sha256

phase_adjudication.dominance_margin: 1 committed cell / tranche size in absolute component magnitude
phase_adjudication.mixed_rule: top two absolute components differ by less than dominance_margin
phase_adjudication.otherwise: label by unique largest absolute component

dynamic_transport.stable_localization: same non-NULL phase label at R100K, R300K and R1M on both engine targets
dynamic_transport.cross_version_regime_concordance: fraction of the three regimes with identical phase labels across engine targets
dynamic_transport.dynamic_reassignment: at least one target changes non-NULL phase label across adjacent regimes
dynamic_transport.cross_version_dynamic_reassignment: both targets exhibit a phase transition and at least one adjacent transition has the same ordered label pair
dynamic_transport.cell_surface: preserve per-cell arm outcomes at every regime for post-sealed transition/Jaccard diagnostics; these diagnostics cannot redefine the primary phase labels

forbidden_inferences: a phase label is an intrinsic timeless property of the engine
